Big waves close beaches along the coast

Jane Rivers
Associated Press

The coast was pounded by large waves on Saturday as a storm far offshore sent a long swell toward the shore, and officials closed several beaches for the afternoon.

Forecasters said the waves would ease by Monday. They warned people to stay off rocks and jetties, where a single large wave can knock a person into the water without warning.

Lifeguards made two rescues near the harbour mouth. Both swimmers were taken to hospital as a precaution and released later in the day, a fire department spokesman said.
